verdict.rationale: Asking whether a vector database can run embedded or as a local instance is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the documented deployment modes are only multi-tenant, single-tenant, and BYOC on object storage. Isolated per-test namespaces are a hosted-service testing pattern, not a local or in-process runtime, so they earn no credit. Nothing in the evidence shows an embedded or lightweight local mode.
